summary: MyTube is a self-hosted media management tool that lets you download and play content from sites supported by yt-dlp. It includes features for managing channel subscriptions, organising a local library, and uploading media to cloud storage.
goodFor: It suits users who want a dedicated interface to automate downloading and organising video content from various supported platforms onto their own hardware.
watchOut: The absence of tagged releases suggests that stability may vary, requiring you to rely on rolling updates or source builds which could introduce breaking changes.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker and Node.js, you will typically need to mount persistent volumes for your downloaded media library and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
